alt: Close-up of the dark grey underside of an Apple Mac mini M4, showing the circular ventilation grille and a power button symbol tucked in the corner, photographed from below against a blue background
story: Apple's M4 Mac mini (launched late 2024) placed the power button on the underside of the device; after 18 months of mockery, Apple 'fixed' this in macOS 26.5 with a Power Control software feature — and the official release notes admit users may 'not have easy access to the computer's power button.'
why_funny: Apple's answer to 'we put the power button where no one can reach it' was to ship a software update so you can avoid ever touching the power button — rather than move the button.
